cases.expected_source: 依据 materials/w03/01_订单日报说明.md、02_财务邮件.md、05_数据字典.md；数据 qinghe-w03-20260923-small。原始 CSV 逐单筛 ordered_at 半开窗口 [2026-08-01, 2026-09-01)，仅 paid；原价=原始 gross，实付=原始 paid，退款=原始 refund，净额=每单 paid-refund，优惠=每单 gross-paid，不扣 refund。成交地区经 orders.store_id→stores.store_id。纳入 O0000001,O0000002,O0000003,O0000004,O0000007,O0000011,O0000012,O0000018,O0000019,O0000020,O0000021,O0000022,O0000024,O0000025,O0000027,O0000028,O0000030,O0000031,O0000033,O0000034,O0000036,O0000037,O0000038,O0000040,O0000041,O0000042,O0000043,O0000044,O0000046,O0000047；窗口与筛选内取消排除 O0000005,O0000039；详见 order-ledger.csv。

actual.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents else 0 end) AS payment_cents
  , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then refund_cents else 0 end) AS refund_cents
  , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end) AS net_sales_cents
  , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents else 0 end) AS gross_cents
  , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents - paid_cents else 0 end) AS discount_cents
FROM "data"."main"."order_facts" order_facts_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'

SELECT
  SUM(1) AS order_count
  , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then 1 else 0 end) AS paid_order_count
  , SUM(case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then 1 else 0 end) AS valid_order_count
  , SUM(case when status = 'cancelled' then 1 else 0 end) AS cancelled_order_count
  , SUM(case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then 1 else 0 end) AS refund_order_count
  , SUM(case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 and refund_cents < paid_cents then 1 else 0 end) AS partial_refund_order_count
  , SUM(case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents > 0 and refund_cents = paid_cents then 1 else 0 end) AS full_refund_order_count
FROM "data"."main"."order_facts" order_facts_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'

cases.expected_source: 依据materials/w03/01_订单日报说明.md购买会员数、退款会员数、成交门店数、有效订单商品件数；02_财务邮件.md有效订单及归属日期；05_数据字典.md一行一单、CRM账户、订单成交门店、quantity原始件数；docs/w03/contract.md与test-guide.md。原small CSV qinghe-w03-20260923-small，orders SHA256=c6e0dee6081e7a6f7782b54de78b3182835c46184c8e7569fc23feab8cf3c4f1。Asia/Shanghai ordered_at半开窗口[2026-08-01,2026-09-01)，先筛窗口及[]；有效单paid且paid_cents>refund_cents，购买账户按member_id去重，成交店按orders.store_id去重；退款账户另筛paid且refund_cents>0再按member_id去重；件数逐有效单累加原quantity，不由退款金额推净销量；卡表不参与筛选或连接。单位count，前三项业务量纲账户/账户/门店，末项业务量纲件，均整数。逐单、逐账户、逐成交门店归属见本目录order-ledger.csv/account-ledger.csv/store-ledger.csv中B3-N01。

actual.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end) AS buyer_count
  , COUNT(DISTINCT case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then member_id end) AS refund_buyer_count
  , COUNT(DISTINCT case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then store_id end) AS selling_store_count
  , SUM(case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then quantity else 0 end) AS valid_order_items

cases.expected_source: 独立从materials/data/small/orders.csv逐行核算，原文件SHA256=c6e0dee6081e7a6f7782b54de78b3182835c46184c8e7569fc23feab8cf3c4f1。时间[2026-08-01,2026-09-01)，成交门店来自orders.store_id，小程序条件仅在F01应用于全部组成量。01_订单日报说明.md规定paid金额/有效订单/购买CRM账户/件数；02_财务邮件.md规定八比率分别的分子分母、分母0未定义；05_数据字典.md规定订单粒度、覆盖和字段。每组入选订单、有效/paid/取消/退款订单集合、购买账户、全部整数分子分母和精确分数见ratio-ledger.json的B4-N01。先在窗口及筛选内分别聚合分子分母再除，不取逐订单或门店比率的平均；有效订单原始件数不扣推算退货件数。所有有限比率存JSON浮点，零分母为null。

actual.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_order_value
  , CAST(SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_buyer_value
  , CAST(SUM(case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then 1 else 0 end) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS purchase_frequency
  , CAST(SUM(case when status = 'paid' then refund_cents else 0 end) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents else 0 end), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_amount_rate
  , CAST(SUM(case when status = 'cancelled' then 1 else 0 end) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(1), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS cancel_rate
  , CAST(SUM(case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then 1 else 0 end) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(case when status = 'paid' then 1 else 0 end), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_order_rate
  , CAST(SUM(case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents - paid_cents else 0 end) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents else 0 end), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS discount_rate
  , CAST(SUM(case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then quantity else 0 end) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS items_per_order
FROM "data"."main"."order_facts" order_facts_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'

WITH sma_10002_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS metric_time__day
    , case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end AS __monthly_buyer_count
    , case when is_monthly_repeat_order then member_id end AS __monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."order_facts" order_facts_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_8.monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count

FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10002_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_8
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS monthly_repeat_rate
  FROM sma_10002_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_15

WITH sma_10002_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS metric_time__day
    , DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at) AS metric_time__month
    , case when is_paid_eligible_month and status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end AS __monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , case when is_paid_eligible_month and status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then 1 else 0 end AS __monthly_paid_order_count
    , case when is_paid_eligible_month and status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end AS __monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , case when is_paid_eligible_month and is_monthly_repeat_order then member_id end AS __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."order_facts" order_facts_src_10000
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(subq_10.metric_time__month, subq_16.metric_time__month) AS metric_time__month
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(CAST(subq_16.monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_16.monthly_paid_buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS monthly_paid_repeat_rate
  , MAX(CAST(subq_16.monthly_paid_sales_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_16.monthly_paid_order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS monthly_paid_avg_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10002_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_10
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
  FROM sma_10002_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_16
ON
  subq_10.metric_time__month = subq_16.metric_time__month
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(subq_10.metric_time__month, subq_16.metric_time__month)
